gettingStarted.title: Getting Started with AffProf
gettingStarted.intro: A 5-minute walkthrough to set up your account, create your first tracked link, and start protecting every click.
gettingStarted.outlineTitle: What you'll do in this guide
outline: Get familiar with your home dashboard
Set up your brand (optional, but recommended)
Create your first product and link
Share your link and watch the analytics roll in
Use quick actions on each link
gettingStarted.outlineNote: You can complete all of this in under 10 minutes. No credit card required.
gettingStarted.whatsNextEnd: Have questions? Email us anytime at

text.createAccountRegisterSuffix: and sign up with your email and a password. There's no email verification step holding you back, and no payment information needed.
text.createAccountFreePlan: The Free plan gives you up to 10 links and 2 products — enough to test AffProf with a real campaign before you decide whether to upgrade.
text.homeDashboardIntroPrefix: After signing in, you land on your
text.homeDashboardIntroSuffix: page. This is your at-a-glance view:
text.homeDashboardTotalLinksText: — how many short links you've created and how many are active
text.homeDashboardBrokenLinksText: — anything that needs your attention right now
text.homeDashboardClicksText: — total traffic across all your links
text.homeDashboardQuickActions: The quick-action buttons let you jump straight into creating a link, opening analytics, or browsing your full link list.
text.brandSetupIntroPrefix: Before creating links, you can configure a
text.brandSetupIntroSuffix: — a saved logo and color combination that AffProf applies to your QR codes automatically. This is optional, but if you plan to share QR codes anywhere (videos, presentations, packaging, in-person events), it's worth the 30 seconds.

text.brandSetupLogoText: — JPG, PNG, or WEBP up to 4 MB. This appears in the center of your QR codes
text.brandSetupQrForegroundText: — the main QR color. Darker colors scan more reliably
text.brandSetupQrBackgroundText: — needs enough contrast against the foreground
text.brandSetupDefaultBrandSuffix: if you want this brand pre-selected every time you open the QR dialog.
text.brandSetupProNote: Branded QR codes (with custom logo and colors) are a Pro feature. On the Free plan, your QR codes still work — they just use AffProf's default style.
text.productLinkTitle: 4. Create your first product, then your first link
text.productIntroPrefix: In AffProf, every link belongs to a
text.productIntroSuffix: . A product represents a brand, blog, channel, or campaign you're promoting. This grouping is what makes your analytics meaningful — you can see which campaigns drive the most clicks, which products have broken links, and so on.

text.utmMediumText: : the type of placement (bio, video-description, email)

text.optionsQrBrandText: : pick a saved brand (from step 3) to style this link's QR code

text.shareAnalyticsTitle: 5. Share your link and watch analytics
text.shareAnalyticsIntroPrefix: Your new link is now live and ready to share. You'll find it in
text.shareAnalyticsIntroSuffix: with a row showing the short URL, the destination, click count, and status.
text.shareAnalyticsTabsIntro: Click on any link to open its detail panel. You'll see two tabs:
text.overviewTabBody: Shows everything about the link itself — the short URL (with a one-click copy button), the destination, product, platform, UTM parameters, tags, notes, and current status. You can disable the link from here, which keeps it in your account but stops the redirect.
text.analyticsTrafficIntro: This view shows everything about the link's traffic:
text.analyticsTotalClicksText: , mobile share, QR scans, and unique countries
text.analyticsClicksOverTimeText: — the full timeline so you can see when traffic spikes
text.analyticsSourcesText: — where visitors come from (direct, social, search, email)
text.analyticsLinkHealthText: — uptime, average response time, and per-check history
text.analyticsRecentClicksText: — every individual click with timestamp, location, device, and whether the redirect succeeded
text.analyticsRecentChecksText: — the full monitoring log with status codes and response times
text.analyticsDashboardPrefix: For a higher-level view across all your links, use the main
text.quickActionsIntroSuffix: table, every row has an actions menu (the three dots on the right) that gives you fast access to the most common tasks without opening the full detail panel:

text.quickActionsCopyShortUrlText: — instantly copies the link to your clipboard, ready to paste anywhere

text.quickActionsQrCodeText: — opens the QR generator modal (more on this below)
text.quickActionsCheckLinkText: — runs an immediate health check instead of waiting for the next scheduled one. Useful when you've just fixed something and want to confirm it's working
text.quickActionsDisableLinkText: — pauses the redirect without deleting the link or losing analytics
text.quickActionsEditText: — opens the create link form pre-filled with this link's settings
text.quickActionsDeleteText: — permanently removes the link and its analytics

text.qrCodesPreviewText: how the QR will look with your logo and colors before downloading
text.qrCodesDownloadPngText: in one click, ready to embed in videos, presentations, packaging, or any physical material
text.qrCodesAnalyticsNote: The QR scans count as a separate metric in your analytics, so you can see exactly how much of your traffic comes from QR-driven sources versus regular clicks.
text.healthMonitoringIntro: This is one of the things that makes AffProf different from a generic shortener. Every link you create is automatically checked on a schedule:
text.healthMonitoringBrokenIntro: When AffProf detects a broken link, two things happen:
text.healthMonitoringStatusPrefix: The link's status in your dashboard changes from

text.healthMonitoringHistorySuffix: section on each link's analytics page (visible in step 5) shows you the full check history: response times, status codes, and which checks passed or failed. You can also trigger an immediate manual check anytime from the actions menu (step 6).

meta.title: Import your existing links from CSV — AffProf
meta.description: Bulk-import affiliate links into AffProf from a CSV in about 5 minutes. Works whether you have 10 links or 1,000.

importLinks.title: Import your existing links from CSV
importLinks.intro: Already have a library of affiliate links in a spreadsheet, another shortener, or a notes app? Import them all into AffProf in one shot — no need to recreate anything by hand.

text.guideDuration: This guide takes about 5 minutes and works whether you have 10 links or 1,000.
text.proFeaturePrefix: Bulk CSV import is a Pro feature. You can
text.whatGetsImportedIntro: When you upload a CSV, AffProf creates:
text.importLinksSuffix: with their slugs, destinations, UTM parameters, and settings
text.importProductsSuffix: mentioned in your CSV that don't already exist in your account (matched by name)
text.importTagsSuffix: mentioned that don't already exist (matched by name)
text.autoCreateNote: You don't need to create products or tags ahead of time — AffProf handles that automatically.
text.openDialogBody: You can either drag a CSV file directly into the dropzone or click to browse for one on your computer.
text.templateDownloadPrefix: If you don't already have a CSV ready, click
text.templateDownloadSuffix: . It comes pre-filled with example rows so you can see exactly how each field should look.
text.templateFieldsSuffix: tab to see the full reference for every column AffProf accepts:
text.requiredColumnsIntro: These four are mandatory for every row:
text.requiredProductDescription: Product name. Created automatically if it doesn't exist. Example:
text.requiredSlugDescription: The short link slug (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only). Example:
text.optionalColumnsIntro: Add any of these to enrich your import:
text.optionalFallbackUrlDescription: Backup destination if the link breaks. Example:
text.optionalActiveDescriptionPrefix: Whether the link is active. Accepts
text.optionalNotesDescription: Internal note (only visible to you). Example:
text.optionalTagsDescription: Pipe-separated tag names. Created automatically if missing. Max 10 per link. Example:
text.minimumCsvIntro: If you just want to get started fast, this 4-column CSV works:
text.minimumCsvNote: You can always edit individual links later to add UTMs, fallbacks, tags, and notes.
text.uploadPreviewIntro: Once you upload your file, AffProf parses it and shows a preview of what it found:
text.uploadPreviewTableText: A preview table showing the first rows so you can spot-check the data
text.uploadPreviewRowNumbersText: Row numbers matching the original CSV (so if there are issues, you can find them in your file)
text.uploadPreviewReplacePrefix: If something looks wrong (a column got misread, the wrong file was uploaded), click
text.uploadPreviewReplaceSuffix: to swap the file before importing.
text.fixIssuesIntro: If some rows don't pass validation, AffProf shows you exactly what's wrong and where:
text.invalidSlugTextPrefix: — only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens are allowed (no spaces, no special characters like
text.slugConflictText: — the slug already exists in your account or appears twice in the CSV
text.importValidRowsTitle: Option A: import the valid rows now, fix the rest later
text.importValidRowsSuffix: — only the valid rows are created. The error rows are skipped, not lost. Fix them in your CSV and re-upload to add the missing ones.
text.fixEverythingPrefix: Open your CSV, correct the rows shown in the issues panel, save it, and click
text.fixEverythingSuffix: to upload the corrected version. Repeat until you have zero issues.
text.errorTipBody: Each error message tells you the exact row number and the specific problem, so fixing them in your spreadsheet is fast.
text.confirmImportPrefix: When all rows look good, click
text.confirmImportSuffix: . AffProf processes the whole batch and shows you a confirmation:
text.confirmImportBody: You'll see exactly how many links were created or updated. Close the dialog and your new links appear immediately in the Links table, ready to share, generate QR codes for, and start tracking.

text.updatesMatchPrefix: The match is based on the

customDomain.title: Connect a custom domain to AffProf
customDomain.intro: Use your own subdomain (like links.yourbrand.com or go.yourbrand.com) instead of the default affprof.com/go/... for every short link in your account.
